decisions.said: There's a really weird edge case where at the monent you swtich to a new chat the latest text message gets duplicated.
decisions.rule: Every app draws each transcript record once: the live tail follows on from the last whole record the history read

description: How an opened past or remote session's transcript is drawn, where it differs from a live chat: drawn from the transcript file in chunks, newest first, with a Show earlier messages button at the top; things only a transcript has (CI events, artifact records, summaries) get their own looks.
opens: Clicking a session in the sidebar

parts.name: Show earlier messages

decisions.said: On mobile baude, I don't seem to get anywhere near the full transcript for long threads.
decisions.rule: Every app opens a long chat on its newest part and reads further back, to the transcript's first record, as it's scrolled up to the top (the desktop's Show earlier messages, the phone's scrolling)

decisions.said: Scrolled to the top of a chat, there wasn't enough sign that more of it was loading above (paraphrased).
decisions.rule: Every app shows its spinner, centred and with no words, at the top of what's still to come above while older messages are being read or drawn there, and keeps what's in view where it is when they arrive

parts.shows: A button centred at the top of the chat while earlier parts aren't drawn: "Show earlier messages (N more)" (or without the count). Earlier chunks (60 items each) also draw by themselves as you scroll near them; the chat is about its full height from the start so the scrollbar doesn't jump. While what's above is still to come, the spinner (no words) shows where it will appear: in the button's place while the start of a long chat is still being indexed; at the top of the part in view of an earlier chunk's place not drawn yet; on the phone, in the chat's first row while there's more of the transcript before its lines, read from the host as it's scrolled up to, for as long as that's asked for (asked again when its host is back up, and a little later each time it fails while up). When it arrives, what was in view stays where it was.

actions.does: Draws the topmost chunk not drawn yet, keeping the view where it is.

parts.name: your messages
parts.shows: As live (UserTurn), images and PDFs attached shown as attachments; injected text (system reminders, local-command output, caveats, task notifications) is never shown as a message. A message the host's sender store says is someone else's is a SenderTurn. The session's first prompt, if it came from outside, is a StartPrompt.

parts.name: replies and calls
parts.shows: As live. Calls whose result never came are shown interrupted (no spinner for ever); background tasks never heard to end are settled as interrupted too. A turn that was stopped gets one "interrupted" note.

parts.name: CI event
parts.shows: A pull-request event the desktop app reported: a small dimmed disclosure titled with what happened (first words of its message, or "A CI event"), folded; opened, its text as markdown.

parts.name: artifact record
parts.shows: Claude Desktop's record of an artifact it published: a small dimmed "Published <title> ↗" line (see Artifact).

parts.name: task notification
parts.shows: Its card (if drawn) ends; otherwise the quiet ending line (see BackgroundTask).

parts.name: compaction
parts.shows: A CompactMark with its summary folded under it.

states.name: opened again
states.shows: A chat opens where it was last left, measured from its end, there at once and held there while what's in it takes its size (pictures, code). One never opened, or left at its end, opens at its end and stays there as pictures and code take their sizes and as new things come (a line or two at once, more gliding in over 200ms). Scrolled up by the reader, it's left where it is. Where each chat was left is kept across the app being closed or restarted, on both apps; a place that can't be put back yet (the host not answering) is kept, and its end shown until the lines come.

decisions.said: Sometimes on mobile when you open an chat it opens like half a screen up from the bottom. It should default open to the last position or the end of the chat hasnt been opened.
decisions.rule: Every app opens a chat where it was last left, measured from its end, and holds it there while pictures and code take their sizes; a chat never opened, or left at its end, opens at its end and follows what comes

states.name: opened, not yet written to
states.shows: No banner and no resumed mark; "— resumed —" appears above your message once you write.

states.name: active elsewhere (tail)
states.shows: New messages appear as they're written, with spinners on running calls; the composer is replaced (see Composer/Banners).

states.name: cut short by a restart
states.shows: The CutShort line at the end.
